authorization: User decisions of 2026-10-02; executed 2026-10-03. Registration committed before any A5 audit or network computation.

audit.loader: fresh cantera.Solution(path) of the unchanged file, sha256 checked before and after loading; never a network phase or clone
audit.coefficients: Kinetics.reactant_stoich_coeffs and product_stoich_coeffs as loaded (float64); atom counts Solution.n_atoms
audit.arithmetic: exact rational: fractions.Fraction of each loaded float64 value; float64 values also reported
audit.turnover: R_ej = sum_k a_ek nu'_kj, P_ej = sum_k a_ek nu''_kj
audit.pair_defect: |delta|/denominator; 0 when denominator == 0 and delta == 0; audit error when denominator == 0 and delta != 0
audit.mass_defect: sum_k W_k (nu''_kj - nu'_kj), kg/kmol, exact rational of float64 W_k and float
audit.B: max pair_defect over every reaction and element of A2NOx; must be finite and > 0

control_rule.rationale: decimal coefficients stored with relative error <= 2**-53; integer atom counts; decimally balanced => |delta| <= 2**-53 (R+P) <= 2**-52 max(R,P)

audit.scope_note: B bounds the local stoichiometric defect per reaction event; 10*B is the user's mechanism-conditioned allowance, not a proof bounding accumulated network element or enthalpy error. B is never derived from observed residuals or outlets. No claim that species renormalization preserves a stoichiometric proof.

g1.design: AE3 TAKE-OFF, used for every mode (P8.5-A4)
g1.test_values: NetworkParams defaults (phi_pz_design 1.8, sigma_rel 0.10, alpha_qq 0.45, volume_scale 1, K 7)

G1.1_temperature_convergence.reference: one HP equilibrium of the total inlet per mode, same inputs
G1.1_temperature_convergence.monotone: abs T errors finite and non-increasing exactly in scale order, no slack

composition_reported_only.note: old composition criterion, reported at every scale; never gating; no full-state equilibrium claim if it fails

creck_control.runs: test values at each mode, take-off design (existing G1.6 runs)

G1.3_sigma0.scope: mixed trace rule applies only to sigma0

g1.verdict: PASS iff A2NOx audit B finite > 0 without error, CRECK audit control rule, and G1.1, G1.2 (A2NOx and CRECK), G1.3 pass at every mode; identity drift => ERROR
